test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum will ₹1,300 give ₹520 as simple interest in 5 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,300

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹520

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Rate (R) = (SI × 100) / (P × T)

**Calculation:**

Rate (R) = (520 × 100) / (1300 × 5)

Rate (R) = 52000 / 6500

Rate (R) = 8%

**The rate per annum is 8%.**
